New synthetic evaluation layouts authored after the prior PHASE39 development set. ReportLab embeds a licensed Noto Sans KR subset (license: ../phase39/OFL.txt, source https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr). No actual customer data or source-document bytes are used. Each PDF has two pages, identity fields on the right, totals on the left, and a second-page goods table with reversed numeric/description columns. The declaration is landscape while transport documents are portrait. They are evaluation inputs, never extraction guidance; filenames are neutralized for real provider calls. manifest.json pins bytes. Regeneration: python generate.py --font=<official Noto Sans KR variable TTF>. Prebuilt PDFs are sufficient for Node tests. These are two scenarios of one new layout family, not six independent real customer forms.
